evidence.detail: May 13 2024 'Restrict season picker to relevant seasons for achievements and archetypes' — wires seasons_active into the archetype view's legal_seasons
self.legal_seasons = seasons_active (list of season IDs where archetype has recorded stats)
season_chooser() disables any season not in self.legal_seasons, giving users a visual indicator of which seasons are relevant

triage.notes: The issue comment asking whether this also applies to the card detail page is addressed by the same mechanism — card.py already computed legal_seasons from PD legality history and the season chooser uses that identically.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in May 2024 (commit 8fa73f4d): the season chooser on archetype pages now disables seasons where the archetype has no recorded data, directly indicating which seasons are worth looking at.
